description: This file defines the EAPMViewDetail class, a PHP class inheriting from ViewDetail, responsible for rendering a detail view of the EAPM module in SuiteCRM. It contains methods for module title setup, display logic, and access control.

classes.name: EAPMViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail to handle the display of detailed EAPM module views.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates parameters for the module title, including icons and links, depending on request parameters and user context.

methods.name: getModuleTitleIconPath
methods.description: Retrieves the icon path for the module title, delegating to the parent class.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares the bean object for display, sets password placeholder, assigns return ID, and enforces access control based on user permissions.
